French dictionary data (dictionary/fr-wiktionary.sqlite)

Derived from English Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org/), contributors listed in each
entry's page history, via the Wiktextract/kaikki.org machine-readable extraction
(https://kaikki.org/dictionary/French/; Tatu Ylonen, "Wiktextract: Wiktionary as
Machine-Readable Structured Data", LREC 2022).

Wiktionary text is available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
International License (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode) and the
GNU Free Documentation License (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/fdl-1.3.html); see
https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights.

Changes: entries were filtered to French, reduced to headword, part of speech, gender,
first IPA transcription, auxiliary verb, up to 12 English glosses, and inflection/
conjugation forms with grammatical tags, then stored as SQLite by
tools/bootstrap-french-dictionary.py. The derived database is distributed under
CC BY-SA 4.0. Source file and SHA-256: third_party/dictionary-fr.lock.json.
